verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a Git hosting platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to create scoped or least-privilege API tokens. The closest items are adjacent: general user permission management and access control lists, an API that exists, and community notes on OAuth2/OIDC provider support. None of these describes issuing per-scope or least-privilege credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
